findings.message: The artifact marks all 10 clauses verified and recommends release, but it does not record any visual results or screenshots. In particular, AC-004 is marked verified despite having no tagged test or responsive visual witness. The approved plan requires visual acceptance separately from automated tests, and the implementation summary says that desktop/tablet inspection is still outstanding. The claimed verification is therefore not substantiated; record the required visual inspection results before claiming completion.
findings.quote: Visual screenshot and desktop/tablet acceptance still require inspection and must not be inferred from automated unit checks.
